beats.say: If you reuse one password, one leak opens every door you have.
A password manager makes a different long password for each site, and remembers all of them for you.
You only remember one strong master password. Make it a long sentence, not a single word.
Your browser or phone probably has one built in, so you can start for free.
Then change your email and bank passwords first, because they matter most.
Start tonight, and send this to the friend who uses the same password everywhere.
